Package de.abas.eks.jfop

Enthält grundlegende Klassen zur Arbeit mit der JFOP-Schnittstelle, insbesondere die auftretenden FO-Exceptions.

See: Description

  • Class Summary 
    Class Description
    CallResult
    Results class of a JFOP call
  • Exception Summary 
    Exception Description
    AbortedException
    Is thrown when a JFOP is canceled by the user.
    CommandException
    Is thrown in the classes EKS, EKSe, FO or FOe if a method call fails.
    EndCalledException
    Is thrown by FOe.input and FO.eingabe, if the parameter endCalledException is equal to true and if the called FOP calls .END.
    FOPException
    Upper class of all Exceptions which are thrown into one JFOP by abas ERP.
    FOPExitException
    If this RuntimeException is thrown in a JFOP, the FO command .error is called with the message and the JFOPs exits with the exit code specified in the constructor.
